svg.title: Prometheus — repetitive tasks, end-effectors and bases

g.text: The same robot takes over other repetitive stations
Stationary handling work that repeats throughout the shift. The end-effector and the base are chosen to fit the task.

svg.text: from a tote, tray or belt
into a fixture or a box
into a slot or a tester
by test result or by type
…and other pick-and-place work at a fixed station
END-EFFECTOR · SWAPPED TO FIT THE TASK
BASE · STATIONARY OR ON A RAIL
